doc: D15 allowlist (H20). Tracked entries under .claude/skills or .agents/skills that are neither a generated pointer wrapper nor backed by a 03-skills home. Every entry needs a reason; an entry whose path is no longer tracked fails the check. Checked by 09-tools/build-local-skill-plugin.py --check.
